milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate from spawn into the sandstone entrance corridor and look toward the red_sandstone_slabs placed at (~-1,0,4) and (~1,0,4). Target is the midpoint (0,0,4), 4 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=3 ensures the player has moved forward into the sandstone zone (not still at spawn). Facing_tolerance=45 confirms visual identification of the slabs.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must turn left through the doorway at X=-3 (Z=6-7) and navigate into the sandstone alcove to locate the chiseled_red_sandstone blocks at (~-6,0,7) and (~-5,0,7). Target is (-6,0,7), which is ~7.6 blocks from the red_sandstone_slab target, requiring deliberate left-turn navigation. Max_distance=3 ensures the player is inside the alcove, not just in the main corridor.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must continue through the central junction into the masonry wing and locate the brick_slabs on the floor at (~0,0,11) and (~-1,0,11). Target is (0,0,11). Max_distance=3 ensures the player is in the masonry section, well past the sandstone zone.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must turn right through the doorway at X=3 (Z=10-12) and enter the stone brick side room to locate the stone_brick_slabs at (~6,0,12) and (~7,0,12). Target is (6,0,12), which is ~6.1 blocks from the brick_slab target, requiring deliberate right-turn navigation into the side room. Max_distance=3 ensures the player is inside the side room.

Uses inventory_has because mining white_wool causes the block to drop as an item which enters the player's inventory. White wool breaks instantly by hand (no tools required) and drops itself. The white_wool blocks are on the left wall of the textile gallery at (~-2,1,16) and (~-2,2,16). The player starts with no white_wool in inventory, so min_count=1 confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must advance deeper into the textile gallery and look toward the light_blue_wool blocks on the right wall at (~2,1,18) and (~2,2,18). Target is (2,1,18). This is on the opposite wall and 2 blocks further in Z than the white_wool, requiring the player to advance and look right. Max_distance=3 with facing_tolerance=45 confirms proximity and visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must turn left through the doorway at X=-3 (Z=18-19) and enter the green wool side alcove to locate the green_wool blocks at (~-6,1,19) and (~-6,2,19). Target is (-6,1,19). This is ~8.1 blocks from the light_blue_wool target, requiring navigation through a doorway into a separate alcove. Max_distance=3 ensures the player is inside the alcove.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must reach the end of the main textile corridor and locate the blue_banner at (~0,1,20), which sits on an oak_planks support block at (~0,0,20). Target is (0,1,20). This is ~6.1 blocks from the green_wool target (different branch direction), requiring the player to return to or remain in the main corridor. Max_distance=3 with facing_tolerance=45 confirms visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate through the green wool alcove to reach the garden area and locate the potted_poppy at (~-6,1,21), which sits on a grass_block. Target is (-6,1,21). Although this is only 2 blocks from the green_wool target (-6,1,19), the 45° facing tolerance differentiates them: from the midpoint (-6,1,20), green_wool requires facing -Z (~180° yaw) while potted_poppy requires facing +Z (~0° yaw) — a 180° difference well beyond the 45° tolerance window.
